title: Xpeng shares sink as weak delivery forecast overshadows $6.3 billion robot unit valuation
summary_full: Xpeng shares slid after weak delivery guidance, even as its nascent robotics business secured a valuation nearly matching that of its core EV business.
summary_public: Xpeng shares slid after weak delivery guidance, even as its nascent robotics business secured a valuation nearly matching that of its core EV business.
